text: Build the hackathon extension: visible idea-to-commit provenance with dependency context
description: Create one coherent, judge-visible capability after 13 July: from an idea, show implementation evidence from Git commits (existing realized-commit signal), the idea's supporting dependencies, and linked-repo context. The experience should answer: what did we intend, what did it depend on, and what code actually realized it? Reuse existing .bowman persistence, linked-repo model, and commit-reference machinery. Keep scope to a polished vertical slice with tests; do not attempt a platform rewrite.

status.comment:
Implementation and internal verification complete; awaiting human review per repository policy.

Implemented visible idea-to-commit provenance: backend Git log query keyed by exact idea UUID, Implementation evidence in AimEditModal beside dependency/repo context, and focused tests. Verified: backend test 1/1, AimEditModal tests 23/23, backend TypeScript build, frontend Vite production build, git diff --check. Full frontend type-check remains blocked by pre-existing TypeScript 6 baseUrl deprecation in tsconfig.

Outcome: Aligned the Git evidence query with MCP reconciliation by searching the stable 8-character prefix. Verified against idea 0733cb72-c746-478c-b06e-ae4faa2af712: the query returned real commit 93fdf3e with author, timestamp, and subject. Effectiveness: The feature now works with established project history and remains compatible with full UUID references because those include the prefix. Backend tests pass 2/2 and TypeScript build passes. Lesson: End-to-end evidence must be tested against repository conventions, not only synthetic parser fixtures.

Outcome: Created commit 9e22fac referencing idea d4e8cdcf. Verified the built Git evidence query immediately resolves that same commit, completing the recursive intent → Codex work → commit → visible evidence proof. Local-only .grok configuration remains excluded. Effectiveness: The commit contains the working provenance feature, tests, idea records, Build Week docs, Devpost copy, demo script, and original project artwork. The public submission can point to one dated, idea-linked implementation commit. Lesson: A self-demonstrating provenance feature becomes materially stronger once its own implementation commit is discoverable through the exact mechanism it adds.
